Metadata.description: A personal archive of photography, development and creative experiments by Loic.

index.title: Follow another thread.
index.introduction: The main essay crosses places and subjects. These stories slow down and follow one visual instinct at a time.

animals.title: Animals
animals.short: Instinct, stillness and lives moving beside ours.
animals.introduction: A study of attention across water, air and leaf — creatures that reveal themselves only when the photographer learns to wait.
animals.metadataDescription: An editorial photography story about animal presence, instinct and quiet observation.

birds.title: Birds
birds.short: Patience, flight and the geometry of a watchful eye.
birds.introduction: A single encounter can contain an entire landscape. Here, patience meets a gaze built for distance and departure.
birds.metadataDescription: A quiet bird photography story shaped by patience, flight and close observation.

architecture.title: Architecture
architecture.short: Structures that measure, shelter and resonate.
architecture.introduction: Cities speak through repetition: a clock face, a turning stair, a vaulted instrument, a platform drawn into the dark.
architecture.metadataDescription: An architectural photography story exploring time, structure, geometry and civic space.

street.title: Street
street.short: Chance encounters along the city's moving lines.
street.introduction: Above ground and below it, the street is less a place than a current — carrying bodies, machines and light toward the next frame.
street.metadataDescription: A street photography story following transit, artificial light and the moving city.

landscape.title: Landscape
landscape.short: Distance, weather and the invitation of an open road.
landscape.introduction: Land remembers light at a different scale. A road offers passage; a ridge holds the final fire of the day.
landscape.metadataDescription: A landscape photography story moving from open roads to the last light on a mountain ridge.

portraits.title: Portraits
portraits.short: Presence, character and the space around a face.
portraits.introduction: Portraiture is a negotiation between a person, a lens and a moment. These public-domain studies hold the place for personal work to come.
portraits.metadataDescription: A portrait photography study using clearly identified public-domain examples pending personal work.

nature-macro.title: Nature & Macro
nature-macro.short: Small worlds where colour becomes landscape.
nature-macro.introduction: Move close enough and scale dissolves. A wing becomes architecture; a flower becomes weather; stillness becomes an event.
nature-macro.metadataTitle: Nature & Macro — Photography story by Loic
nature-macro.metadataDescription: A nature and macro photography story about colour, nearness and delicate forms.

abstract-details.title: Abstract & Details
abstract-details.short: Shape, rhythm and familiar things made strange.
abstract-details.introduction: The recognizable world bends into circles, currents and measured marks — details freed from their original purpose.
abstract-details.metadataTitle: Abstract & Details — Photography story by Loic
abstract-details.metadataDescription: An abstract photography story discovering rhythm, geometry and unfamiliar forms in ordinary subjects.

culture-events.title: Culture & Events
culture-events.short: Gathering places, ritual and rooms that remember sound.
culture-events.introduction: Culture leaves traces in instruments, interiors and shared silence. Even an empty room can feel charged with an audience.
culture-events.metadataTitle: Culture & Events — Photography story by Loic
culture-events.metadataDescription: An editorial photography story about cultural spaces, resonance and collective memory.

still-life.title: Still Life
still-life.short: Objects arranged until their silence begins to speak.
still-life.introduction: Fruit, flowers, books and tools become small theatres of weight and balance. These public-domain examples mark space for a personal series.
still-life.metadataTitle: Still Life — Photography story by Loic
still-life.metadataDescription: A still-life photography study using clearly identified public-domain examples pending personal work.

road.title: The First Line
road.narrative: The road does not simply cross the valley; it gives the eye a direction. Distance becomes an invitation before the journey has properly begun.
road.alt: A bright road curving through green mountain fields under a clear sky

butterfly.title: Small Gravity
butterfly.narrative: A pale wing holds against impossible colour. The photograph rewards nearness, but also restraint: one more step would break the spell.
butterfly.alt: A white butterfly resting on vivid magenta flowers

heron.title: The Patient Witness
heron.narrative: Stillness is not absence. In the heron's eye, waiting becomes concentrated movement — a whole body listening for the instant to leave.
heron.alt: Close profile of a heron with a vivid yellow eye and long beak

ridge.title: A Ridge Remembers Fire
ridge.narrative: For a few minutes, stone carries the colour of flame. Below it, snow and shadow already belong to the approaching night.
ridge.alt: Snow-covered mountain ridges glowing orange in the final sunlight

clocks.title: Blue Hour Keeps Time
clocks.narrative: Three faces measure the same evening differently. Around them, the city changes shift from daylight into illuminated order.
clocks.alt: Historic clock towers framed by buildings beneath a deep blue evening sky

metro.title: The City Climbs
metro.narrative: Steel and stone share the last gold of the day. The train appears briefly above the street, then carries its anonymous story elsewhere.
metro.alt: A metro train crossing an elevated Paris bridge in golden light

spiral.title: Down to the Centre
spiral.narrative: Function disappears from this height. The staircase becomes orbit, repetition becomes pull, and the floor waits like a distant fixed point.
spiral.alt: A spiral staircase seen from above circling toward a patterned centre

organ.title: Cathedral of Breath
organ.narrative: Metal columns wait beneath the vault. Their silence has weight because the room already seems to remember every note.
organ.alt: An ornate pipe organ illuminated within a vaulted stone interior

underground.title: Night Line
underground.narrative: Below the city, colour replaces weather. Orange, violet and steel turn an ordinary platform into a stage between arrivals.
underground.alt: A curved underground station with an orange train and luminous platform lights

jellyfish.title: Electric Afterlife
jellyfish.narrative: Body becomes current and edge becomes light. It moves without horizon, carrying its own atmosphere into the dark.
jellyfish.alt: A luminous blue and amber jellyfish floating in deep darkness

frieda-claus.title: A Quiet Interior
frieda-claus.narrative: A composed gaze and softly modelled light make restraint the subject. The portrait holds its era without surrendering the person inside it.
frieda-claus.alt: Historic monochrome portrait of Frieda Gertrud Claus seated in profile

jessica-meir.title: Built for Elsewhere
jessica-meir.narrative: Person and equipment occupy the frame as equals. The suit is both setting and symbol, turning a formal portrait into a threshold.
jessica-meir.alt: Black-and-white official portrait of astronaut Jessica Meir wearing a space suit

ida-harper.title: The Direct Gaze
ida-harper.narrative: Formal pose gives way to direct attention. Small choices in posture and expression resist the distance imposed by the archive.
ida-harper.alt: Historic studio portrait of writer and activist Ida Husted Harper

nathan-mossell.title: A Life in Bearing
nathan-mossell.narrative: Clothing, posture and expression form a deliberate record. The image preserves achievement through the simple force of presence.
nathan-mossell.alt: Historic formal portrait of physician Nathan Francis Mossell

photographer-studio.title: Portrait of a Practice
photographer-studio.narrative: The camera turns back toward its own world. People, tools and painted scenery reveal portraiture as both encounter and construction.
photographer-studio.alt: A nineteenth-century photographer and group posed inside a working studio

fruit-study.title: Weight and Ripeness
fruit-study.narrative: Fruit gathers light along curved surfaces. The arrangement feels abundant, yet every object is held in careful visual balance.
fruit-study.alt: Historic still-life photograph of fruit arranged on a tabletop

vase-flowers.title: The Held Bloom
vase-flowers.narrative: A vessel gives temporary order to growth. Petals press outward while the composition holds them inside a measured silence.
vase-flowers.alt: Historic still life of flowers arranged in a vase

books.title: Pages at Rest
books.narrative: Closed books keep their contents invisible, leaving texture, edges and accumulated weight to tell the story instead.
books.alt: A still-life arrangement of stacked and open books

barber-tools.title: Tools Between Gestures
barber-tools.narrative: Objects shaped by repeated use wait in suspension. Their arrangement maps an absent hand and the ritual it performs.
barber-tools.alt: Barbershop tools carefully arranged for a still-life photograph

ceramics.title: A Quiet Vessel
ceramics.narrative: A porcelain bowl makes volume from emptiness. Its rim, glaze and gentle asymmetry turn a useful object into a study of held light.
ceramics.alt: A porcelain bowl isolated in a restrained still-life composition

photography.introduction: Photographs made while paying attention — to quiet gestures, changing landscapes and the beauty hidden in ordinary days.

essay.label: A photographic passage
essay.title: From first light to the electric dark.
essay.introduction: Ten images arranged as one journey: beginning in open country, following life into the city, then descending beneath its surface toward something stranger.
essay.direction: Scroll slowly / the atmosphere will follow

road.title: The Road Opens
road.copy: A pale line through the valley. Every story needs somewhere to begin, and every departure first looks like possibility.
road.alt: A bright mountain road curving through green fields beneath a clear blue sky

butterfly.title: Small Gravity
butterfly.copy: The world contracts to a stem, a wing, a few grams of life holding perfectly still in the sun.
butterfly.alt: A white butterfly resting on vivid magenta flowers

heron.title: The Patient Witness
heron.copy: Nothing moves except the eye. Presence becomes its own kind of landscape when we stay long enough to notice.
heron.alt: Close profile of a heron with a bright yellow eye and beak

ridge.title: Last Fire on the Ridge
ridge.copy: The day leaves slowly, setting the stone alight before cold blue settles into the snow below.
ridge.alt: Snow-covered mountain peaks glowing orange in the final sunlight

clocks.title: Blue Hour Keeps Time
clocks.copy: Nature gives way to measured streets. Three clocks hold the evening while windows begin to glow.
clocks.alt: Historic clock towers framed between buildings beneath a deep blue evening sky

metro.title: The City Climbs
metro.copy: Steel rises through old stone, carrying a green line into the last warm edge of the day.
metro.alt: A metro train crossing an elevated Parisian bridge in golden light

spiral.title: Down to the Center
spiral.copy: The city folds inward. Steps become orbit, architecture becomes motion, and the floor becomes a distant star.
spiral.alt: A spiral staircase seen from above, circling toward a patterned center

organ.title: Cathedral of Breath
organ.copy: Columns of metal wait in the half-light, an immense instrument poised between silence and thunder.
organ.alt: An ornate cathedral pipe organ illuminated inside a vaulted stone interior

underground.title: Night Line
underground.copy: Orange walls, violet light, a train holding its breath. The city continues beneath the city.
underground.alt: A curved underground station with an orange train and glowing platform lights

jellyfish.title: Electric Afterlife
jellyfish.copy: At the end of the line, form dissolves into current. The journey finishes somewhere that feels alive, but no longer earthly.
jellyfish.alt: A luminous blue and amber jellyfish floating in deep darkness

development.introduction: A record of interfaces, experiments and technical ideas explored through code, motion and thoughtful interaction.

work.label: Development work
work.title: Built with curiosity.
work.introduction: Selected digital work spanning product interfaces, immersive systems and experiments made to understand what the web can become.

interfaces.title: Clear interactions
interfaces.copy: Interfaces that balance structure, speed and motion without losing sight of the person using them.

systems.title: Immersive systems
systems.copy: Browser experiences where real-time graphics, code and interaction share the same space.

experiments.title: Useful detours
experiments.copy: Prototypes and technical studies created to learn, question familiar patterns and find better ones.

profile.workImageAlt: Loic photographing a landscape with an analog camera
profile.caption: Behind the lens / France

about.label: About this archive
about.title: One person. Two ways of looking.
about.copy: I move between photography and development because both begin with the same impulse: observe closely, understand the structure, then make something honest from it.

archive.label: A living portfolio
archive.copy: Not a storefront. Just the work, the process, and the things I want to remember.
